description: Insert a part, a whole Part Studio or another assembly into an assembly. Insert from a version when pulling from a different document.

configuration.description: Encoded configuration for the inserted element.

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

is_assembly.description: The source element is an assembly.

part.description: Part id, to insert a single part.

src_doc.description: Source document id (defaults to the target document).

src_elem.description: Element id of the source Part Studio or assembly.

src_version.description: Source version id, required when inserting across documents.

whole_studio.description: Insert every part of the source Part Studio.

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_insert_instance
title: Insert an instance
